breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use arithmetic-mean area of 350 mm^2 for axial-deformation calculation,' which directly repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this instruction entirely and relies solely on the exact integral with the varying area A(x). The agent failed to eliminate this incorrect substitution, even though it also listed the correct integral formula, creating an internal contradiction in the specification.
